Name: all-servers
Description: Every server
Purpose: The root of the host nesting chain; one host is a direct member rather than reached through a child

Name: web-servers
Description: Web front ends
Purpose: Second level; the target of the engineering HBAC rule and the platform sudo rule

Name: db-servers
Description: Database servers
Purpose: Second level; a sibling with one member

Name: bastions
Description: Jump hosts
Purpose: Second level; every member requires a second factor

Name: build-runners
Description: CI runners
Purpose: Second level; anyone may reboot these under sudo

Name: legacy-hosts
Description: Hosts still on an end-of-life OS
Purpose: Filled by an automember rule on the operating system; where the ID view applies

Name: site-zurich-hosts
Description: Hosts in the Zürich office
Purpose: Filled by an automember rule on locality; non-ASCII description

Name: empty-hostgroup
Description: A host group with no members
Purpose: A report has to handle zero members; the managed netgroup FreeIPA creates for it is empty too
